title: UFC Fight Night 284: Gamrot vs. Salkilld
original_title: UFC Fight Night 284: Gamrot vs. Salkilld
overview: UFC Fight Night 284: Gamrot vs. Salkilld was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on August 8, 2026, at the Meta Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States. A lightweight bout between former KSW Featherweight and Lightweight Champion Mateusz Gamrot and Quillan Salkilld headlined the event.
